decisions.reason: Reusing the existing Sign In background for the Provisioning Wizard changes the wizard styling requirement, not the Sign In page styling; the Sign In background was already required and derived from the landing-page treatment.

The shared informational-page treatment already specifies a landing-page-derived background, header logo, and optional footer. Reusing that background for the wizard does not change the shared treatment.
The Provisioning Wizard background and styling decision does not alter the footer's content, links, social items, copyright, or background color.

The same message separately addresses panel placement, but the source Provisioning Wizard styling modification does not affect Console navigation. The navigation clause is already represented by its own same-message MODIFY.
The need to revisit wizard styling supplies no new or changed design-token values, categories, font assets, dimensions, or button states.
Provisioning Wizard page styling is distinct from the Console shell container and does not change its components, theme modes, style dimensions, or deliverable.
Reusing a background derived from existing website styling for the Provisioning Wizard does not modify the landing page's visual-design requirements.
The wizard styling modification does not change the website implementation stack, handoff objective, or landing-page delivery obligations.
The Provisioning Wizard background decision does not change the established absence of website header navigation.
The source provides no responsive-layout, breakpoint, viewport, or device-specific change for the website.
